supersedes.reason: Remediation re-review confirmed the original three findings were closed and then found omitted SVG and Worker-class browser fetch surfaces. This manifest binds the expanded URL-attribute matrix and executable/remote-resource denial.

checks.result: All six focused tests passed; the boundary matrix includes coherent regenerated/rehashed remote SVG image references and rehashed Worker construction in addition to no-op generation, remote CSS/fetch, hosted-route, governance, workflow, and concurrency cases.
The clean exact second-remediation commit passed all 15 mandatory foundation commands and all 129 foundation tests; build provenance reported 0.1.0+g1ee236a clean.
The ledger and generated planning views validate with both independent changes-requested rounds preserved in the audit trail.

evidence: The HTML URL matrix now covers standard navigation/media/script/form fetches, SVG image/use/feImage href and xlink:href, legacy fetching attributes, source sets, meta refresh, portals, and local target confinement.

Governed HTML, CSS, and JavaScript reject remote resource literals; executable surfaces additionally reject fetch/XHR/WebSocket/EventSource, Worker/SharedWorker/importScripts, sendBeacon, service-worker registration, and worklet module loading.

A coherent generator revision that emits a remote SVG image, regenerates its page, and rehashes every governed artifact fails the network gate while still satisfying generator reproducibility; a separately rehashed Worker mutation also fails.
The canonical RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.3 reference remains accepted with the exact approved identity, all 54 hashes, aggregate package hash, and required page/workflow/capability counts.
The report remains deterministic and the UI-reference checker remains a mandatory foundation command.

The complete browser dependency surface is validated statically without browser launch or network access, and generator reproduction stays confined to immutable snapshots in an isolated temporary directory.
The exact clean commit passes the full foundation profile and preserves both independent review dispositions plus their superseded evidence.

reviewerDisposition.note: Independent re-review must confirm coherent remote SVG and rehashed Worker-class mutations are denied, all prior findings remain closed, and the full T02 acceptance/evidence chain remains valid.
